research_scopes.thermal-storage: Declared thermal, storage, eclipse and survival model questions; protected architecture choices remain reserved.
research_scopes.swarm-power: Existing illumination, coverage, GEO delivery and beam-control models.
research_scopes.materials: PV degradation and metasurface abstraction within declared material assumptions.
research_scopes.resource-intelligence: ARCI score/confidence and synthetic target measurement.
research_scopes.research-tooling: Reproducibility, evidence parsing and research instrumentation; no authority/CI changes.
research_scopes.public-synthesis: Prepare research explanations; external publication belongs to Observatory.

rationale: M approved complete bounded research cycles in Issue #79. These are per acceptance-slice ceilings, not default generation targets. Tests and dependency installation are not scientific runtime consumption. Frozen experiments may impose smaller budgets. No spending, model training, private export, evaluator/holdout changes after freeze, or new hardware-readiness claims.
